algorithm: LLM planner (atomic operations + geometric point/axis constraints) solved by a constrained trajectory optimizer, with an MCTS variant (STCR) for LLM-planning-failure recovery; downstream policies trained with Diffusion Policy (DP) and 3D Diffusion Policy (DP3)
sim: SAPIEN (also described as ManiSkill3 in Appendix C.2)
success_criterion: binary per-task success criterion, itself LLM-generated (e.g. "all cubes being successfully placed inside the bowl")
headline_metric: generation/execution success rate across HGen-Bench's 20 tasks vs. RoboTwin baseline
headline_value: average success rate of over 50% across 20 tasks, most task types above 75% (§5.1)
note_gaps: Per-task numbers for the §5.1 RoboTwin comparison are only given qualitatively (bar chart), not tabulated; exact per-evaluation episode count for downstream DP/DP3 policies is not stated beyond '3 random seeds'.
